BiblicalUsage: Cheshbown is the reckoning, the account a person makes when he searches a matter out to the end, and Ecclesiastes is its only home. The preacher applies his heart to seek out wisdom and the reason of things, counts one by one to find the account, and warns that in the grave there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the search for the true account of things is the work of a wise life. I hold that only God keeps the final reckoning straight, and His account is the one that will stand.
